What changed
Unified TV card — all three panels (chart · composite · radar) live in one bordered card, sharing the same dark TV palette + Trebuchet typography.
Single header strip — splits into 3 cells matching the body columns. Left cell shows OHLC quote + legend, middle shows "Composite Score", right shows "5-Pillar Radar" — same indent/border-style as TV's header rows.
Thin vertical separators between the 3 columns (1px var(--line)) so they read as TV "stacked indicator panels".
Aligned 520px height across all 3 columns — the chart, score, and radar all fill the same vertical space.
Indicator-style sections inside score + radar (sub-headers like "pillar contribution" · "vs benchmarks") with the same border-bottom treatment TV uses for indicator settings.
